description: Elixir's System.halt("slogan") writes an erl_crash.dump with the slogan and exits 1; System.halt(:abort) aborts the VM with a core dump. fz-sc8.7 builds integer statuses only; these two raise FunctionClauseError until built. Decide fz's analogue of a crash dump (or document its absence) and build both on interp, run and build against elixir.
title: System.halt/1 with a binary slogan or :abort
